01 THE UMHLANGA DIFFERENCE

LITTLE PEOPLE. LIMITLESS POTENTIAL.

Their world is growing.
We make room for it.

The right beginning changes everything. We bring small classes, individual attention and a caring community together, so your child can grow into who they are.

An independent, co-educational school from Grade RRR to Grade 3. Rooted in a Muslim ethos of kindness, honesty and respect, with a holistic approach to academic, social, physical and spiritual growth.

04 OUR EDUCATORS

THE PEOPLE BEHIND EVERY BEGINNING

Hearts fully invested.

Meet the educators who help our learners discover, grow and belong.

OUR TEACHING TEAM / 05

Educator

Ms. Nawaal

I'm Ms. Nawaal. I strive to be an educator who makes a difference and inspires a love for learning. As an educator, it is my job to shape learners as a whole ... mind, heart, and body. Holistic development produces learners who are confident, caring and capable individuals, ready for life beyond the classroom.

Educator

Mrs Khan

I’m Mrs Khan, a passionate and caring educator who believes every child deserves to feel valued, encouraged and inspired. I strive to create a happy, nurturing classroom where little minds grow, confidence blossoms and a love for learning begins. “Little minds, big dreams, endless possibilities.”

Grade RRR & RR educator

Ms. Lalitha

I'm Ms. Lalitha! I teach Grade RRR and RR, and I enjoy being part of my little learners’ early learning journey. I aim to create a warm, caring and welcoming classroom where every child feels safe, happy and excited to learn. I believe learners learn best through play, creativity and hands-on activities, while developing important skills and confidence along the way. Watching them grow, celebrate their achievements and discover new things each day is what makes teaching so rewarding to me.

Grade R educator

Mrs Maiter

I'm Mrs Maiter. I am a passionate Grade R educator with a heart for little learners. I believe Grade R is where confidence, kindness and a love for learning begins. My classroom is a happy, colourful space, where every child is celebrated - like busy little bees, we learn, play, and grow together. Teaching curious hearts every day is my greatest joy.

Educator

Mrs Davenarian

I'm Mrs Davenarian . I believe that every child is unique and learns in his/her own special way. My goal is to create an environment where learners feel confident to ask questions, try new things, make mistakes, and grow at their own pace. I feel privileged to be part of each child's journey, helping them build confidence, develop a love for learning, and discover the joy of learning through play. Together, we will learn, laugh, explore, and grow!

A MESSAGE FROM OUR FOUNDING FAMILY

“Your children don’t just join a school —
they join our family.”

With gratitude,
The Family
Founders & Owners

Welcome to Umhlanga Primary School. Founded by a family of Educators, UPS is an independent school. Teaching is our passion. Three Generations of family members that continues to serve as educators, principals and mentors. Umhlanga Primary School was born from a simple dinner table conversation : “Let’s create a unique school where every child is known by name, with small classes that allow for individual attention.” We opened our doors in 2015, with small numbers, but a big dream. Today that dream lives in every learner, who walks through our doors, every parent who trusts us and every educator who shares our calling. At UPS , your children don’t just join a school – they join our family. We warmly invite you to visit our school, meet our family and experience the difference.

Founded by a family of educators, for families who value education.

A little more

Ask us a question
What should I bring when applying?
  • Official birth certificate.
  • Immunisation card.
  • Transfer card when moving from another school, or the latest report card if a transfer card is unavailable.
  • Applicable residence or study permit for non-South African citizens.
Which grades are available?
Our school offers Grade RRR to Grade 3. Please contact the school to confirm availability in your child’s grade.
Is aftercare available?
Aftercare is offered. Contact the school for current times, fees and arrangements. Madressa classes are also available after the normal school day.
How do I find out about fees?
Please contact the school for the current fee schedule and application information.
